Hi all —

Thanks again for your time earlier this week. We wanted to pull together a short multi-prospect roundtable/demo to walk through a focused set of patterns for inference at scale (cache + batching, dedicated vs hosted routing, cost controls).

Proposed slot: Wednesday, Nov 25 at 10:00 AM PT (45 minutes). Draft agenda attached and a short demo deck (see attachments).

- 5m introductions and quick context
- 20m focused demo (retail + multitenant routing)
